parameters.name: Info
parameters.description:
要处理的漏洞的信息。该参数为JSON格式，包含以下字段：

- namespace：镜像命名空间
- repoName：acr镜像仓库名
- regionId：地域
- instanceId  acr实例id
- repoId 仓库id
- tag 镜像原tag
- digest 镜像digest
- newTag 镜像修复后tag
- uuid 镜像uuid
- ids 漏洞主键id列表

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas operate-image-vul --info namespace_:_cloud_oa0000_,_repoName_:_hybirdc0000_,_regionId_:_cn-shanghai_,_instanceId_:_cri-rv4nvbv8iju40000_,_repoId_:_crr-2q7302qrofxg0000_,_tag_:_hybird-cloud-web_fix_1671159450000_,_digest_:_e1a4fd25884ca2ef8840bb252c9926e4f549df9e046500dd93539b2d458c0000_,_newTag_:_hybird-cloud-web_fix_1671159960000_,_uuid_:_4ad91dd8c0c02de6574fa98085d00000_,_ids_:_197540864,197540865,197540869 --operate-type vul_fix --type cve --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
